title: Theresa May to Be Britain’s Second Woman Prime Minister

image.attribution: Foreign and Commonwealth Office / Wikimedia Commons / CC-BY-2.0

main_content:
Britain’s Theresa May is set to become the second woman to hold the position of Prime Minister since Margaret Thatcher.

British Prime Minister David Cameron announced on Monday that he will resign Wednesday.

The prime minister announced his intention to resign last month after Britons voted in a referendum to leave the European Union.

Theresa May, 59, has served as Home Secretary in Cameron’s cabinet since 2010. May had been campaigning in a race to lead the Conservative Party against Energy Minister Andrea Leadsom.

But Leadsom withdrew after she made comments highly criticized by the media and her party.

During last month’s referendum, also referred to as “Brexit,” May campaigned for Britain to stay in the EU.

Speaking outside parliament, May said she was “honored and humbled” to be chosen the party’s new leader.
